test_title: PYST 09: SSC JE EE - General Intelligence (Held on 07 Jun 2024 Shift 3)
subject: reasoning
question:
Select the triad in which the numbers are related to each other in the same way as are the numbers of the given triads.

(NOTE: Operations should be performed on the whole numbers, without breaking down the numbers into its constituent digits. E.g. 13 - Operations on 13 such as adding /deleting/multiplying etc. to 13 can be performed. Breaking down 13 into 1 and 3 and then performing mathematical operations on 1 and 3 is not allowed.)

(12, 9, 96)

(14, 7, 84)
solution:
The logic followed here is:

Logic: 1st number × (2nd number - 1) = 3rd number.

Now,

For, (12, 9, 96)

⇒ 12 × (9 - 1) = 12 × 8 = 96.

For, (14, 7, 84)

⇒ 14 × (7 - 1) = 14 × 6 = 84.

Similarly, For **(18, 11, 180)**

**⇒ 18 × (11 - 1) = 18 × 10 = 180.**

Hence, the correct answer is Option 3.
